admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-14 (outposts): Ashmore and Cartier Islands, an Australian external territory, is in scope as a wilderness game map under the user-assigned code XA because it has no ISO 3166-1 code of its own. OSM maps it as relation 2559345 (boundary=administrative, admin_level 4, wikidata Q133888, no ISO3166-1 tag) whose two outer rings, ways 623059854 and 623059853, are both present and closed in the pinned Geofabrik ashmore-cartier file. The relation is used only as the OSM-mapped extent of the game map. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
